findings.status: new (DB125 keep-off list added by the R21-MEC-01 fix)
findings.title: ORDERING 8.2 DB125 keep-off list leaves out four bottom parts inside its own 1.76-2.17 mm range

evidence.file: docs/ORDERING.md section 8.2, bullet 'Hand-solder the eight DB125 bodies'
evidence.claim: Bottom-side parts sit 1.76-2.17 mm (copper edge to edge) from the DB125 holes; keep the iron and any nozzle off them: J121 U5, R13; J440 D440, D441, R90, TP82; J410 D410, D411; J420 D420, D421, C421; J9 D400, D401, C91; J122 R150-R153.
evidence.measured: B.Cu SMD pad copper to DB125 pad copper (1.9 mm ring), pcbnew polygons: R102.4 to J9 1.997 mm; C410.2 to J410 2.003 mm; C420.2 to J420 2.003 mm; C431.1 to J9 2.050 mm. All four are nearer than U5 (2.171 mm), which is listed. Listed parts re-measured: R13 1.762, D410 / D420 / D421 / D400 / D401 1.771, C91 1.800, D411 1.808, R153 1.825, C421 1.850, D440 1.865, R150 1.890, R151 / R152 1.894, D441 1.900, R90 1.953, TP82 2.100, U5 2.171 mm (list values confirmed). Next out: R405 2.24, R102 to J420 2.299, C411 2.30 mm.

findings.impact: An assembler working from the list would treat R102, C410, C420 and C431 as outside the keep-off although they are as close as the parts it names. Bounded: if JLC hand-solders (the default the remark asks for), the risk is an iron touching a 0402/0603 joint, caught at first-article inspection. No hardware failure.
findings.concrete_fix: Text only: add 'J9: R102, C431; J410: C410; J420: C420' to the keep-off bullet, or restate the rule as 'every bottom-side part within 2.2 mm of a DB125 pad (list generated from the board)'. Optionally have check_r10 generate the list so it cannot drift.

findings.title: Assembly drawings show no body outline for 14 parts and no Fab mark at all for 5 (Q122, Q123, D120, D123, J2)

evidence.file: m3_design/assembly_review/fab/m3_assembly_top.pdf / m3_assembly_bottom.pdf (rendered at 300 and 900 dpi in the probe dir); board F.Fab / B.Fab
evidence.measured: Fab graphics per footprint (pcbnew): none for Q122 (F), Q123 (B), D120 (B), D123 (F), J2 (F); only a 0.06 mm pin-1 dot (bbox < 0.6 mm) for U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, D4, D121, Y1, J3. In the renders U1 (LQFP-100), U4 (bottom LGA IMU), U3, U5, Y1 and U2 appear as a bare reference with no body; Q123 and D121 have hidden silkscreen designators, so the drawing is the only identification and it shows neither body nor pin 1 / polarity. The board silkscreen does carry pin-1 / polarity marks for all 14 (F/B.Silkscreen circles or polygons), so the bare board is not unmarked.
evidence.related: R20-MFG-03 listed the 14; D-R20-07 / D-R21-08 fixed reference placement and presence only.

findings.impact: Documentation / inspection aid defect: ORDERING 8.2 tells the assembler to inspect pin 1 and polarity of Q120-Q124, D120, D121, U1-U5 against the drawings, which cannot show them for these parts. Bounded by the silkscreen marks and JLC's own placement preview; no fabrication effect.
findings.concrete_fix: Generator-only (board file changes, copper and placement unchanged): draw a 0.1 mm Fab body rectangle and a pin-1 / cathode mark for the 14 footprints (r10_parts / kilib), re-export the PDFs and refresh the hash binding. Or, text-only, record it as an accepted deviation and tell the assembler to use JLC's placement preview for these 14 parts.
